candidate_findings.title: The iframe sandbox does not enforce the asserted network denial
candidate_findings.claim: The module receives allow-scripts and the text asserts that arbitrary external network loads are denied, but no CSP, fetch interception, URL rewriting, embedded-resource policy, or host egress enforcement is specified.

candidate_findings.title: The non-iframe sanitizer policy is not a closed, versioned contract
candidate_findings.claim: The baseline depends on DOMPurify DEFAULT_ALLOWED_TAGS and unspecified approved URL-bearing attributes, without pinning a DOMPurify version or defining exact attributes, protocols, SVG namespaces, CSS handling, parser configuration, or malformed-input behavior.
